titulo_fr: Un profil personnel : Observer les formes
titulo_es: A personal profile: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It includes a short presentation and distinguishes personal data from preferences. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It includes a short presentation and distinguishes personal data from preferences. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention: Possessive and verbs present help to follow who presents who and what he likes. In this fragment, «frère» means «brother».

frases.es: Vive con su hermano y le gustan las películas cómicas.

frases.fr: Le samedi, il lit au café près de la gare.

frases.en: On Saturdays read in the coffee near the station.
